uci_confirmation.adjudication: checkmate, stalemate, insufficient material, automatic/claimable draws, or draw at maximum plies; no evaluation adjudication
uci_confirmation.forfeit_rule: engine exception, timeout, null move in a live position, or illegal move loses immediately
uci_confirmation.decision_rule: Forcing-3 confirms only with zero candidate faults, zero opponent forfeits, and a 95% opening-pair-bootstrap score lower bound above 50% against searched-3-baseline; Stockfish-100n is an external anchor without a pass threshold
